svg.title: PTv3 with a persistent polar token stream
svg.desc: Proposed architecture: point, action and polar token streams interact through full joint patch self-attention in every Concerto block. Polar tokens are data-conditioned by a polar MLP and learned query resampler. Five backbone stages project channels while preserving action and polar token counts. Language conditions all streams. Existing action outputs use final point and action features.

text.tspan: PTv3 + a persistent polar token stream
Staged proposal · MVP: joint point / action / polar attention in every Concerto block
Three feature streams persist through all five stages
Stage transition: grid-pool P · separate channel projections for A and Z
Q = P, A, Z · K/V = language
Training only (optional): retain reconstruction loss on a cloned encoder hierarchy.
Same mechanism at every stage; C follows the current stage width.
P ↔ A · A ↔ Z · Z ↔ P
A and Z share FFN weights
Q = each of P, A, Z
→ Updated P, A, Z for next block
Each patch attends to both global streams; patch-wise A/Z updates are merged and carried forward.
Serialization, sparse CPE and grid pooling apply only to P. Global A/Z tokens never enter voxel pooling.
B = batch size · N = points · K = points per patch · C = stage width
Later ablation: a dense polar image encoder can initialize Z, including pixels without valid depth.

svg.text: Later: dense polar [B, 4, H, W] + 2D PE
